question_en: Can you arrange a pickup/transfer from Saranda, Albania to Lefkada?
answer_exact: To be honest, we do not offer transfer services outside of Greece. However, if your transfer is within Greece, please let us know the location and I will be happy to request a quote for you.

question_en: Can we end the charter in Kefalonia instead of returning to Lefkas, because of flight connections?
answer_exact: The skipper can arrange your disembarkation in Kefalonia should you wish to do so. However, please note that as the yacht is required to return to its base on Friday by 17:00, the disembarkation in Kefalonia would need to take place no later than 13:00 on Friday, depending also on the exact port in Kefallonia and weather conditions on the day. Alternatively if you opt for coming back to the base and disembark on Saturday morning as per the standard procedure, there is a direct ferry connection from Vasiliki to Kefalonia. Vasiliki is located in the southern part of Lefkada, approximately 40-50 minutes from our base. Ferry route: Vasiliki (Lefkada) -> Fiskardo (Kefalonia), approximately 1 hour to 1 hour 10 minutes. Option B: ferry from National Port of Lefkas, Lefkada Town -> Sami (Kefalonia), approximately 3.5 hours.

statement: Broker flow: broker sends booking and documents; client pays IonionSails directly; we confirm when funds arrive; after the deposit and balance (final) payment is received we tell the broker so they can issue the commission invoice (one broker said it issues it after the second payment). We send our company details for the commission invoice; broker returns the invoice document. Payment reference must be the booking confirmation number. For amended bookings the broker invoices commission only on the extra amount.

Base is Lefkada / Port of Lefkas only for these cases; starting from Corfu is refused (8-10 h sailing, night arrival, extra marina cost, deposit processing by phone not recommended). Ending in Kefalonia is possible with disembarkation no later than 13:00 on Friday, weather and port permitting. Ferries: Vasiliki to Fiskardo about 1h to 1h10; Lefkada Town to Sami about 3.5 h. Zakynthos is reachable from Lefkada in a week. Saronic base (second base): not found in these threads.

Broker partners receive the Welcome on Board email addressed "Dear Partners" with booking confirmation, charter party and Boarding Pass. Payment confirmation to broker: team replies once funds appear in the account. Broker booking documents updated to include the professional skipper (12 Aug 2026).
